message: Verdant 15.4.1 fixes duplicate-class compile errors when VCC is installed over older extracted Verdant UnityPackage files.
notes: Legacy Verdant-managed scripts are now removed by exact path during VCC migration instead of relying on GUID matching.
Fixes duplicate VerdantVRCLinkingInstaller compile errors between Assets and Packages.
Keeps scene objects, cats, supporter props, lighting and world-specific assets untouched.
Includes the V15.4 supporter-scroll and shared-clock fixes.
